notes: Lead profile: small CS automation startup building a lightweight layer on top of Zendesk/Freshdesk.
Primary ask: hosted API for low-friction self-serve POC. Keep everything in public cloud; no private deployment required at this stage.
Workloads: nightly bulk summarization of ticket threads + on-demand agent-assist drafting. Also webhook-triggered tool-calls to create/update tickets (tool calling).
Latency/throughput: per-call latency preference 150-300ms for quick agent interactions; batch summarization can be async (minutes). Low concurrent QPS (mostly <50).
Cost sensitivity: high. Wants to understand per-1000-token unit economics; will start with free credits then convert if fit. Estimated monthly tokens initially <5M.
Model preferences: open to small/efficient variants. Interested in quantized variants if quality loss acceptable. Care about deterministic structured JSON outputs for downstream ingestion.
Security: needs SSO (SAML) for team, SOC2 report, audit logs for API calls, ability to scrub PII before storage. Asked about KMS — for now wants Redwood-managed keys; revisit if enterprise.

POC plan proposed by Oliver: 1) Hosted API onboarding link + test prompt set (this week). 2) Integrate webhook tool-calls to create ticket actions (2 weeks). 3) Run 1-week pilot with real tickets; measure summary accuracy and tokens/cost. 4) Decide on reserved capacity if growth >50k daily tokens.
Quotes from call: 'We need clean JSON outputs that our workflow can parse — not free-form summaries.'
Notes: Mentioned they use Zapier for current automations; would prefer direct webhooks. Interested in streaming partial outputs for longer summaries but can start with full response mode.
Legal: flagged data retention Qs — want to ensure short retention and option to purge PII. Legal to follow up after POC (estimated 1 week).

Action items: send onboarding link, include example prompt templates for ticket summarization + structured schema, include a short cost example (approx per-1k tokens), attach SOC2 summary doc and audit log sample.
Potential to expand to Dedicated in 12-18 months if they hit mid-market customers and need stricter controls. For now, priority: low friction, fast time-to-value.
